items.q: Do you supply Water for Injection (WFI)?
items.a: No: we supply a Purified Water (PW) package in polypropylene, not Water for Injection (WFI), pure steam or stainless steel. It covers pretreatment, reverse osmosis, deionization or electrodeionization, and distribution; no stills. Where your product needs WFI (injectables, vaccines, biologics), you generate it; PW is the usual feed to a WFI still.

items.q: Do cosmetics and personal care lines need PW?
items.a: Not always: drug lines need PW under drug good manufacturing practice (GMP); cosmetic-only lines follow your written specification.

items.q: My industry is not listed. Can you help?
items.a: Yes, when the fit above holds. Send your standard, its edition and grade, and where the water is drawn: each tap, machine or line.
